module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder 0, depends on gameplay_drift_general) that relays drift gameplay events to flowgraph nodes. It listens to the hooks onDriftSpinout, onDriftCrash, onDonutDriftScored, onTightDriftScored and onDriftCompletedScored, and keeps each event in a callbacks table with a lifetime (ttl) of 2 ticks that nodes can read.
notes: The callbacks known at init are tight, donut, spinout, crash, tap, scored; each has ttl = 0 at the start.
An event is considered active as long as ttl > 0; onUpdate decrements the ttl by one per call.
addCallback sets ttl = 2: the event stays visible for about 2 updates.
onDonutZoneReactivated is not declared in C.hooks; it is called directly and relays to gameplay_drift_drift.onDonutZoneReactivated().

resetModule.desc: Recreates the callbacks table with all events at ttl = 0.

init.desc: Called when the module is created: calls resetModule().

onUpdate.desc: Called on every manager update: decrements the ttl of each positive callback.

getCallBacks.desc: Returns the callbacks table (key = name, value = {ttl, data}).

addCallback.desc: Registers (or replaces) an event with ttl = 2 and some data.

name.desc: event name (tight, donut, spinout, crash, scored...)

onDriftSpinout.desc: Hook: the player spun out; registers 'spinout'.

onTightDriftScored.desc: Hook: tight drift scored; registers 'tight' with {score}.

onDriftCompletedScored.desc: Hook: drift completed and counted; registers 'scored' with addedScore, cachedScore and combo.
